vb_textbox.text: The colours in the game may be in pairs. Green goes with brown and purple goes with red. If you pick the green or brown and get 4 or more, stay with green or brown. When the number of mushrooms drops below 4, change to red and purple. if this stays below 4 go back to green and brown. It should return to 4+ returns for green and brown. it may be the case that you stay with green and brown throughout. who knows
